constraint_quotes: The first line contains integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 0 ≤ k ≤ 9).
The i-th of the following n lines contains integer a_{i} without leading zeroes (1 ≤ a_{i} ≤ 10^9).
constraints: Two header integers n,k followed by exactly n integer tokens.
No leading zeroes in any a_i's magnitude representation.

parsing_policy.numeric_notation: ASCII decimal integers with optional + or - sign; leading zeroes accepted unless explicitly forbidden. Unicode numeric notation remains unverified.
parsing_policy.whitespace: Leading/trailing blank space, blank edge lines, in-line tabs/spaces and CRLF are accepted. Semantic or token-count violations are invalid before checking layout.
parsing_policy.line_layout: After domain validation, deviations from the stated line token grouping are unverified:layout_ambiguity, not invalid.
parsing_policy.huge_integers: After stripping sign and leading zeroes, more than ten digits is represented by an out-of-range sentinel; all domain upper bounds are <=10^9.
parsing_policy.result_contract: valid means the implemented stated constraints hold under the documented notation conventions; it is not proof of original contest parser acceptance.

assumptions: An optional plus sign is treated as numeric notation, not an extra character disallowed by the mathematical integer domain.
The no-leading-zero condition applies to a_i only, after an optional sign. It does not constrain n or k.
Input layout ambiguity remains separate from clear domain violations.
Provided normal inputs are consistency checks, not an authoritative completeness proof.
